desc: The Stroup SD1 push dagger is simple, solid, and devastatingly effective. This one-of-a-kind dagger is the brainchild of Wilder Tactical and Stroup Knives and will mount to just about anything. Its simple construction includes a strong 1095 high carbon steel blade and handle, milled G10 scales, two sets of screws, and a sheath. That's it. No moving parts to fail and few blocky edges to snag during presentation; it's exactly what you want in a CQC knife. The blade is chisel ground for excellent penetration and easier resharpening with the dual edges terminating at a perfect tip. Handmade look and feel, built for real-world combat use.
